name: caute
description: Caute is the library you own, that every assistant can cite: search what you've caught, ask it questions, and save to it.

interface.longDescription:
Caute keeps web pages, PDFs, email, recordings and conversations as you caught them. Connected, ChatGPT can search your library by words or meaning, ask it questions and get answers that cite the exact passage, read what you saved, save new things, write notes, remember what you tell it across assistants, and suggest tags and properties that wait for you to confirm them.

It is for people who read and save a lot and want their assistant to work from what they kept: researchers, writers, students and teams.

ChatGPT sees only the spaces you choose when you connect, never a space you keep away from AI, and you can disconnect it in Caute's settings at any time. It cannot delete anything you saved; the one thing it can remove is a memory it wrote itself. You need a Caute account.
capabilities: Search your library by words or meaning
Answer questions with citations to saved passages
Read saved pages, PDFs, email and notes
Suggest tags and properties for you to confirm
defaultPrompt: What did I save about kelp forests, and what did I think of it?
Ask my library whether kelp stores carbon.

positive.description: Find saved cards on a topic and read one
positive.prompt: What did I save about kelp forests, and what did I think of it?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's saved cards about kelp forests with their titles and links to app.getcaute.com, and quotes the reviewer's note on the kelp article. Every quoted passage comes from a saved card.

positive.description: Answer a question from the library with citations
positive.prompt: Ask my library whether kelp stores carbon.
positive.expected_behavior: A short answer in which every sentence cites a saved card, with links to those cards. If the library doesn't say, it says so rather than answering from elsewhere.

positive.prompt: Save this page to Caute: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelp_forest
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the page was saved and gives its card link. The card appears at the top of the test account's timeline in Caute within a few seconds.
Returns the highlighted passages about sleep in the test account, each with the card it comes from.

positive.description: Remember a preference for next time
positive.prompt: Remember that I prefer short answers with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms it was remembered. The memory appears on the Memory page in Caute, named as written by ChatGPT, and recall returns it in a new conversation.

negative.description: Deleting saved cards is not offered: no tool deletes a card
negative.prompt: Delete everything I saved about kelp forests.

negative.description: Another person's library is never reachable: the connection reads only the spaces the signed-in person chose
negative.prompt: Show me what jane@example.com has saved in Caute.

negative.description: Sending mail is outside Caute: it has no tool that emails anyone
negative.prompt: Email my kelp forest notes to my colleague.

review.commerce_description: Caute does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, ask with citations, read, save, notes, memory across assistants, and suggested tags and properties.
